entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
.... Opposite Parties
 Mr. Manmaya Kumar Dash,
 Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice K.R. Mohapatra
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
Order No. 03.12.2025
 01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Ms. Das, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that an application under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for brevity 'the Act') was filed on 3rd January, 2025.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: But the said application was rejected on 20th February, 2025 on the ground that earlier the Collector, Malkangiri has disposed of the said matter in Misc. Case No.2 of 2024 pursuant to the direction of this Court in W.P.(C) No.39976 of 2023.
2.1. Ms. Das, learned counsel for the Petitioner further submits that the earlier order was with regard to disposal of his representation.
But no prayer to refer the matter under section 64 of the Act was made therein.
Thus, the instant application under section 64 of the Act was maintainable.
3. Mr. Dash, learned Additional Standing Counsel prays for an adjournment to take instruction in the matter.
4. Put up this matter on 9th January, 2026 along with W.P.(C) No.31105 of 2025 indicating the name of learned counsel appearing therein in the cause list.
Instruction, if any, shall be obtained in the meantime positively.
Judge Santosh Biswas vs State Of Odisha And Others ....
